sessions.title: The gods must be... back?
sessions.summary:
Ayeluna "Lou" becomes an initiate of the Mages of High Sorcery. Bud Turtlefoot and Zacharia Horn-Axe find a temple with some statues of the gods reformed and get divine powers. Kena Price and Sibyl Eirlynn, while escorting Lord Bakarishome, run into some monsters on the road and kill them with the help of the rest of the party and Ispin Greenshield. 

The party arrived in Vogler, a small fishing village on the Vingaard River that most of the party are very familiar with. Vogler was a flurry of activity, with villagers preparing for the upcoming Kingfisher Festival. Ispin introduced the party to Cudgel Ironsmile, a dwarven woman who leads the Ironclad Mercenaries. Her group is planning on participating in the Battle of High Hill - a reenactment of that famous battle that happens every year at the climax of the festival. Cudgel offered to walk with Ispin on his nightly rounds. The next morning the party discovers that Ispin is dead.

sessions.title: Five Games and one funeral
sessions.summary:
The party investigated Ispin's death, discovering that he was murdered with a sharp weapon. They questioned Cudgel and realised that the person who last spoke with Ispin was either dominating Cudgel or disguised as her as she seemed to have no memory of that event and she had an alibi during that time. The party searched Ispin's house and found letters indicating that he was investigating rumors of an army in the region. They attended his funeral the following day and then prepared to participate in the Kingfisher Festival.

At least one party member participated in each event. Bud's brother Jud won the fishing contest, Sibyl won the log rolling, Edrik and Zacharias tied in the horse race, Becklin won the chess tournament, and Kena won the wrestling match.

sessions.title: IT's a trap!
sessions.summary: The party participated in the remaining festival games. Zacharias won the pie eating contest and Bud won the talent show contest. Most of the party decided to join in the Battle of High Hill while Bud opted to sit in the stands and watch. As the battle began, it became apparent that the Ironclad Mercenary members who had joined the battle, were using real weapons. The party fought them off, managing to rescue a few villagers from danger. After the fight, they interrogated two of the surviving Ironclad members and discovered a plot, hatched by someone called Kansaldi Fire-Eyes, to raze Vogler to the ground. After returning to the village and discussing the situation with Mayor Raven, the party advised the town to begin evacuating to Kalaman, the nearest large city.
